You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system and the exact names your specification must define so that it binds to a fixed model-checking configuration. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior and defines exactly the named constants, variables, and operators listed below. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module specifies a fast mutual exclusion algorithm with two distinct process classes, generated from a PlusCal algorithm named FastMutex. Processes in 1..M execute one control-flow copy and processes in (M+1)..N execute a second structurally similar copy, coordinating through shared variables x, y, and b to compete for entry to a critical section. The specification defines initialization, per-process actions, the overall next-state relation, a standard temporal specification with weak fairness for each process class, a mutual exclusion invariant asserting that no two distinct processes are simultaneously in the critical section, and a liveness property requiring that some process enters the critical section infinitely often.

Your module MUST define these names so the configuration binds: Spec, N, M, Invariant, Liveness
